credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Full length portrait of O'Keeffe standing in the darkened doorway of her Abiquiu house facing the patio; her hair is pulled back from her face, she wears a sleeveless high-collared ankle length dark cotton dress belted with her favorite Taxco black suede and sterling sliver belt; she stands facing the camera with her right arm ( in viewer left) extended out to the wall with her hand leaning on the adobe  entrance way.
title: Georgia O'Keeffe in Front of Abiquiu House Salita Door
